title: Ned's Rainy Day Dam
note: b417 — Phase 5 continues (School readiness) — review of split digraphs and early alternative pronunciations (y as igh/ee, a as o, e as ee).

pages.brief: Ned the duckling standing at the edge of a small stream, looking at the flowing water with purpose.
Ned the duckling picking up smooth round stones from the muddy bank of the stream.
Ned the duckling arranging a line of stones across the narrow stream.
A single stone tumbling away from the line, pulled by the moving water.
Ned the duckling picking up one large, flat grey stone, bigger than the others.
Ned the duckling pressing wet mud into the gaps between the stones with his beak.
Raindrops dotting the surface of the stream around Ned and his stone dam.
Water calmly pooling up behind the dam of stones, the flow slowed to a trickle on the other side.
Ned the duckling sitting proudly beside a small calm pool of water held back by his dam.
Ned the duckling floating happily on his new still pool as the rain falls gently around him.
